gpt-5-mini.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 1910 opened 2018 with gross claims outstanding of GBP 322.1m. The Syndicate reports an overall improvement (release) in prior year reserves of GBP 11.6m (3.6% of opening gross reserves), citing favourable claims development and recoveries from reinsurance as the primary drivers. 2018 was a volatile year with numerous catastrophe and large loss events (e.g. Hurricanes Florence and Michael, Californian wildfires, Lurssen shipyard fire) which affected current-year results, but the net prior-year movement reported was an improvement. The Syndicate highlights the effectiveness of its reinsurance and retrocession programme in managing net catastrophe exposure.

As in 2017 the net impact of these events was managed due to the effectiveness of the reinsurance and retrocessional programme purchased to protect against such large events.
Following the major loss events of 2017 we anticipated a material increase in the rating environment for reinsurance.
The Syndicate also experienced a number of large losses in the year including the Lurssen shipyard fire, Onshore energy losses in the final quarter and Power outage losses.
